crossRefs.note: For first of all, when you come together in the assembly, I hear that divisions exist among you, and I partly believe…
The days of visitation have come. The days of reckoning have come. Israel will consider the prophet to be a fool, and…
Many of them said, “He has a demon, and is insane! Why do you listen to him?”
Others, mocking, said, “They are filled with new wine.”
As he thus made his defense, Festus said with a loud voice, “Paul, you are crazy! Your great learning is driving you…

translations.web: If therefore the whole assembly is assembled together and all speak with other languages, and unlearned or unbelieving people come in, won’t they say that you are crazy?
translations.bsb: So if the whole church comes together and everyone speaks in tongues, and some who are uninstructed or some unbelievers come in, will they not say that you are out of your minds?
translations.kjv: If therefore the whole church be come together into one place, and all speak with tongues, and there come in those that are unlearned, or unbelievers, will they ➔ not say that ye are mad?
translations.asv: If therefore the whole church be assembled together and all speak with tongues, and there come in men unlearned or unbelieving, will they not say that ye are mad?
